_version: Trailer 1.1 -- the approved 1:50 music edit followed by a five-second silent hold on the KubeCon URL card.
_what: TRAILER 1 -- a promotional cut derived from the PROLOGUE, not a ninth act. It reuses the prologue's source (Nightwish's 'Perfume Of The Timeless'), its main title and its wolves bridge, then adds two owner-written lines over the book sequence and a KubeCon end card. It is delivered to ~/Videos/Wolves/trailer-1.mp4 and takes no numeral, no chapter marker and no slot in stories/megacut/megacut.json: the programme is unchanged by it.
_owner: 2026-08-16, in order: 'Now make a new video: Trailer 1 - make a copy of this video and then / Add dialogue boxes over the words in the book section :25 - :33 so that we can say words, account for the movement because we want to "replace" these words with our overlay, wolves style / Two Generations of Contributors / One, new, one old. Fighting to work together. / Then make the wolves fade longer and more dramatic and add a KubeCon | CloudNativeCon North America / Salt Lake City, Utah / #KubeCon #CloudNativeCon #7wolves at the end. Let the music play out longer than the original video, look up how long movie trailers should be given the things we have / Sear the | again'. Then: 'you can even go to :36 actually and skip the shot of the tank and go right to the iguana again'. And, on the second line: change 'Struggling to build together.' to 'Dreaming to build a better future'.
_owner_2026_08_17: 'The text box for the message is too wide, let's do this: Two Generations of Contributors / One at their beginning / One at their end / These are their Real Stories. Change the evolve or die into two messages, lengthem them to show them lead to the kubecon text, have the text be Extinction is the Rule / Survival is the Exception. all three text messages should floow smoothly into one reveal.' Asked which capitalisation the first book line should carry, the owner kept the existing 'Two Generations of Contributors'; asked where the Kubernetes helm should go now that no line contains 'Evolve', the owner put it on the O in 'Extinction'; asked whether the lengthened cards should extend the film, the owner held the runtime at 1:50.000, so both cards were seated inside the existing 14.000 s bridge and no music-timed beat was re-measured.
_length: 1:55.020 total. Picture 88.200 + bridge 14.000 + end card 12.820. The music ends at 1:50.020, then wolves.projectbluefin.io holds for five silent seconds.
_climax: 1:47.000 is the wolves-fade trailer climax. The source audio fades 107.000 -> 110.020, then the KubeCon URL card holds silently through 115.020. no wolf sound is added, synthesized, moved, or processed.
_the_tank_is_cut: Scene boundaries DETECTED on the source, not taken from the owner's timestamps: the book runs 24.880 -> 33.640, the empty specimen jar in the library 33.640 -> 36.320, and the iguana 36.320 -> 40.720. The owner asked to skip the tank and go straight to the iguana, so 33.640 -> 36.320 is excised and the two halves are joined with a short dissolve. THE AUDIO IS NOT CUT THERE. The song runs continuously from the source, so the music carries over the picture edit -- which means picture and sound run 2.680 s apart after 33.640, deliberately, and every timing below the join is in FILM time.
_the_watermark: The source carries Nightwish's burned-in './/. Arena.' mark top right through every one of these shots. It is publisher copy and nothing in this brief asks for its removal; redactions/ is the route if that is ever wanted. Left alone, recorded here.

plates.note: Beat two, with the credit line, its sear, and the tagline row made visible. Both staged cards carry the same body so the rows always occupy their space and the two PNGs are identical above them; `stage` decides only visibility.

ONE BOX, ONE BOOK SHOT. Owner: 'make one continuous box and put the text on one shot and hold it. do NOT cover the iguana.' All four authored lines live in this single stationary fancy-subtitle band, 26.900 -> 32.900; it is CUT in and it never leaves on its own: the box is composited onto the HEAD LEG of the picture, so the join dissolve carries the page and the box out together at 33.320 -> 33.640. Owner, 2026-08-17: 'HIDE THE WORDS ON THE BOOK PAGE WITH THIS SLIDE AND THEN FADE INTO THE IGUANA'. The page goes on printing underneath -- 'In order to be born', then 'you needed' in close-up -- and all of it sits inside the box's footprint, so any frame where the box has left and the picture has not cut reveals the words the box is there to cover. Its `dur` therefore runs to the head's own end at 33.640. Owner, 2026-08-17: 'don't fade the box on it's own it reveals the text underneath' and 'before switching to the iguana' -- a card that is mostly filled panel spends an alpha ramp semi-transparent, so the book's printed lyric reads through it, worst at the out, which lands right on the shot change. The panel is opaque for the same reason.
plates._copy: OWNER COPY, verbatim. Owner, 2026-08-17: 'The text box for the message is too wide, let's do this: Two Generations of Contributors / One at their beginning / One at their end / These are their Real Stories'. The retired second line -- 'One, new, one old. Dreaming to build a better future' -- was 52 characters and drove the box out to its 82% max width; four short lines are content-width and narrow it without a CSS change. The window opens 1.400 s earlier (28.300 -> 26.900) because four lines take longer to read than two; the book shot starts at 24.880, so the earlier in point is still inside it. Then, on the size: 'the box in the first part is too small, increase text size and the vertical space inbetween each sentence, show me mockups' -- four were rendered over the book frame itself (2.65rem/1.20, 3.10/1.45, 3.45/1.55, 3.80/1.70) and the owner chose the largest, 'D is the best'. And on the colour: 'get rid of the blue here', so this card does not ask for the project's blue b/f letters. THE BLUE LEFT EDGE STAYS: it is the card's one Bluefin element and it is chrome, not a recoloured letter inside a word. If the owner meant the edge too, it is one line in cards/bookline.html.

plates.note: INTENTIONALLY EMPTY. The second line moved into book-a when the owner chose one continuous stationary box on the book shot. This entry remains only because the build's fixed input layout still reads plate_book-b.png; an empty body makes the card transparent and it covers nothing.

plates.title: Extinction is the Rule
plates.note: MESSAGE ONE OF THREE. Owner, 2026-08-17: 'Change the evolve or die into two messages, lengthen them to show them lead to the kubecon text ... all three text messages should flow smoothly into one reveal.' One centered marquee line over the day wolves, bridge-local 0.600 -> 5.600, with the O in Extinction rendered as the white Kubernetes helm -- the mark the retired 'Evolve or Die' card carried on its own O. Owner, 2026-08-17: 'lower the extinction and other line to be more in the dark area for readability', so both day cards carry placement 'low'. The seat was MEASURED on 03-day.png under the type's own bounding box rather than nudged by eye: the original 38% seat reads mean luma 59 / p95 125 across the dawn horizon, and the 58% seat reads mean 48 / p95 73 in the flower meadow below it. It is 58% and not lower because 66% -- the first pass -- laid the line across the foreground wolf's head, which the owner caught: 'bring it up some now you're covering the wolve's head'.
plates._copy: OWNER COPY, verbatim. It replaces 'Evolve or Die', which is retired along with the earlier 'The Final Shape is Kindness' and "Wolves aren't Evil".

plates.title: Survival is the Exception
plates.note: MESSAGE TWO OF THREE, bridge-local 6.200 -> 12.400. It takes the frame as the first card leaves it -- the fades are adjacent rather than separated by a hold -- and clears 1.600 s before the end card begins, so the KubeCon reveal lands on empty night wolves. NO HELM: one mark across the pair, on the first line, or it reads as a bullet rather than a letter.
plates._the_one_reveal: The three messages are one reveal by continuity, not by a new transition. The bridge's night wolves and the end card's night wolves are the same image and there is no black between them, so both day cards, the sinking wolves and the KubeCon card all play over one uninterrupted picture. Nothing outside these two windows moved: the trailer is still 1:50.000 exactly, and the end card's fades are still on the measured RMS moments in the source music tail.

plates._no_blue: The card's b/f rule is NOT applied to this title. 'KubeCon' and 'CloudNativeCon' are Linux Foundation marks set as type, and recolouring a letter of somebody else's trademark is a different decision from recolouring a letter of our own. The divider is drawn without touching the words. Reversible in one flag if the owner wants the b -- see cards/maintitle.html.

unresolved: The end card names KubeCon and CloudNativeCon as text only -- no logo, no mark is fetched, and nothing here is cleared or needs clearing. If a mark is ever wanted on this card it is a rights decision and blocks; text is not.

The book lines' drift is modelled as a straight walk between two measured anchors with a fixed tilt. The page also scales slightly as the camera pushes in, and that is NOT modelled -- the type holds one size across each beat. Visible only if the beats are lengthened.

Michroma, the site's display face for this overlay, is not installed on this host, so every card here resolves the act slides' stack exactly as cards/act.html does. Recorded as the substitution it is.
